items.html: And just as the three aforementioned Yud-Hei-Vav divide into the ten Sefirot of the Chochma of AA, and their root is one Yud-Hei-Vav, so too these two Ahyh divide in the throat into six Ahyh, in its ten Sefirot. And this is because also in the GAR of the throat, in which is the first name Ahyh, which is the root of Aba who is in the throat, and it is in the Milui of Yudin: Alef, Hei-Yud, Yud, Hei-Yud. And the second Ahyh is also of Yudin, which is the root of Ima. For just as the name Yud-Hei-Vav is the entirety of the ten Sefirot of Chochma, so the name Ahyh is the entirety of the ten Sefirot of the throat, except that the Yud-Hei-Vav of Chochma divides into three Yud-Hei-Vav as mentioned, while the Ahyh of the throat divides into six Ahyh, since it contains the entirety of Aba and Ima.
